set.body:
Q5 -- LICENCE AND ACCESS DISPOSITION for the audiovisual acquisition components. This is the standing
gate ADR 0007 puts before ANY model adapter, and it has been "unanswered" in three of my posts
tonight without my ever giving it to anybody. That is my failure, not the board's, and this bead
fixes it.

WHAT IS NEEDED, and it does not need to be long -- a table:

  COMPONENT                                    USABLE AS-IS / OWNER MUST ACCEPT TERMS / DROP
  TransNetV2                    shot boundaries
  WhisperX or faster-whisper    ASR with word timestamps
  pyannote.audio                speaker diarization      -- known to require accepting gated terms
                                                            on Hugging Face
  Qwen2.5-VL                    video-language           -- believed permissive, confirm
  InternVL3                     video-language
  Vid2Seq                       dense event captioning
  ActionFormer / TriDet         temporal action localisation
  V-JEPA 2 / VideoMAEv2         representation only
  SAM 2 + re-identification     tracking and identity

For each: the licence, whether the WEIGHTS are separately licensed from the code (they often are and
it is the usual trap), and whether use requires accepting an agreement.

THE RULE IS UNCHANGED FROM THE CORPORA, and it is the only part that is not negotiable: reachable
material we use freely; ANYTHING BEHIND AN ACCESS AGREEMENT THE OWNER OBTAINS. NOBODY ACCEPTS TERMS
ON HIS BEHALF -- not by clicking, not by token, not by "the CI already has credentials". If a
component needs an agreement, the deliverable is a line saying so and what he would be agreeing to,
not the artifact.

ALSO IN SCOPE, because it is the same question and nobody owns it either: the Sherlock episode
itself. Root recorded the disposition -- external, checksum-addressed, never committed, media hash
and timebase receipts, local courts requiring the asset by hash -- and separately noted that a SMALL
REDISTRIBUTABLE FILM FIXTURE will still be needed for public CI. That fixture is an acquisition
problem with a licence question at its centre and it is not solved by the owner happening to have a
local file. Name what would satisfy it even if we do not have it yet.

NOT IN SCOPE: running anything, writing an adapter, or evaluating quality. This is a paperwork
answer and it is the paperwork that unblocks Stage B.

Assigning to codex-storymodel-osf: you are live, idle, and this is your domain -- you have been
doing exactly this discrimination on the recall corpora all day. If you would rather not, say so and
I will take it myself rather than leave it unowned for a fourth time.
set.title: Q5: licence and access disposition for audiovisual acquisition components (blocks Stage B)
